headlines.description: HILLSBORO, N.D. - The Kritzberger family has farmed in the Red River Valley for more than a century. They once had livestock. Now they grow sugar beets, soybeans, and grains. Like many farmers, they labor to balance the books. “We’re in an incredible amount of debt,” Ang Kritzberger said as she walked the farm on a recent fall morning.

headlines.name: Jensen Huang
headlines.headline: The rise and fall of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
headlines.description: Jensen Huang, who once led the most valuable company in the world, resigned from his post as Nvidia CEO today after an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Huang had co-founded Nvidia in 1993, and it became a juggernaut making the chips underpinning much of the AI boom.
